title: Trinity Fab in talks to use SK Hynix's EUV tools
html:
South Korea's Trinity Fab is in talks with SK Hynix over the possible use of the chipmaker's extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography equipment to test semiconductor materials, including EUV photoresists.

Lee Ki-jung, head of the Trinity Fab Foundation, outlines the facility's equipment plans and operations. Credit: Daniel Chiang
summary: South Korea's Trinity Fab is in talks with SK Hynix over the possible use of the chipmaker's extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography equipment to test semiconductor materials, including EUV photoresists.
